description: Patient-reported adverse event intake record. Patient identity is XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted with the patient's passkey-derived key + sealed-recipient to Council Lv6+ DIDs per ADR-2605181100. Public aggregated narrative (no PII) is emitted by pharma_post_market_surveillance daily. G5 (public reporting) + G10 (patient identity non-traceable) + Charter Rider §2(c) (no resale to advertisers / insurers / employers). Per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G5/G10 + ADR-2605250545 §Decision 6.

lotAttestationUri.description: Back-reference to the lot the patient received. Allows full safety-signal investigation.

encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope.description: CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope. Plaintext contains patient_did, contact preference, and any patient-supplied context. Sealed-recipient = Council Lv6+ DIDs only. NEVER decryptable by ad / insurance / employer entities. Optional only when submission is via anonymous form.

deviceFingerprintHash.description: Optional for anonymous form submissions; SHA-256 of (device user-agent + locale + tz), used only for dedupe — never for re-identification.

severity.description: CIOMS Form III standardized severity scale.

onsetTimingMinutesAfterDose.description: Onset timing in minutes after dosing (integer; use 60 for 1 hour, 1440 for 24 hours).

narrative.description: Patient-authored description of the event. SHOULD NOT contain personally identifying information; intake validator scrubs obvious PII patterns before commit.

symptomCodes.description: MedDRA SOC / PT codes (LLT optional). Used for histogram aggregation.

reChallengePositive.description: If patient resumed the product after symptoms resolved, did symptoms recur?
